result.summary: Found 2 issues: a stuck loading indicator blocking the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image and inconsistent styling of the favorite heart button.

issues.description: White circular loading spinner stuck in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar cover image under 'Popular right now', obscuring the food photo
issues.suggestion: Fix image loading so loader dismisses after load; add caching, timeout, and error fallback image if load fails

issues.description: Favorite heart icon on Tokumaru Ramen Bar card has no dark circular background, unlike the pizza card below it, making it inconsistent and low-contrast against the image
issues.suggestion: Apply the same dark translucent circular background/scrim to all favorite heart buttons for consistency and visibility
